Account Information : Name on Account : XXXX XXXX Account Number : XXXX Date of Unauthorized Activity : XX/XX/XXXX NAME ON ACCOUNT : XXXX XXXX XXXX ACCOUNT NUMBER XXXX XXXX  DATE OF UNAUTHORIZED ACTIVITY : XX/XX/XXXX NAME ON ACOUNT : XXXX XXXX  ACOUNT NUMBER : XXXX DATE OF UNAUTORIZED ACTIVITY : XX/XX/XXXX NAME ON ACCOUNT : XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX DATE OF UNAUTHORIZED ACTIVITY : XX/XX/XXXX I request that you immediately investigate this matter, freeze the account, and take the following actions : 1. Close or freeze the account to prevent further unauthorized activity.

2. Remove any negative information related to this account from my credit report. 
3. POLICE REPORT NUMBER : XXXX In addition, I have filed a report with the Federal Trade Commission ( FTC ) about this identity theft incident, and I am including a copy of the FTC Identity Theft Report for your records. You can verify this report using the information below.

Details for FTC Identity Theft Report : FTC Report Number : FTC Report XXXX Date Report Filed : Date XXXX If you require additional information or documentation to assist in the investigation, please contact me at AT THE ADDRESS ABOVE.

Sincerely, XXXX XXXX

March 17, 2026

Natasha Graham
4422 Pine Bluff Way
Arlington, TX 76010

RE: Account reference: ACC-437902

Dear Ms. Graham,

Re: Account reference: ACC-437902

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account ACC-437902. We take all disputes seriously and are committed to resolving this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and the laws of the State of Texas.

We understand that you have disputed the account as a result of identity theft. We must investigate this claim and verify the accuracy of the account information. As required by the FDCPA, we will validate the debt and provide you with the original creditor's name, Metro Physicians Group, and the amount of the debt, $10,221.03.

We will conduct a thorough investigation into your claim and review the account information. If our investigation confirms that the account was opened without your authorization, we will take the necessary steps to resolve the matter.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that our investigation does not accurately reflect the facts. You may also request that we provide you with additional information or documentation regarding the account.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and will keep you informed of our progress. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Redstone Collections Group

May 22, 2026

Oscar Fitzgerald
1018 Elm Court
Springfield, MO 65801

RE: Account reference: ACC-356736

Dear Mr. Fitzgerald,

Re: Account reference: ACC-356736

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the amount owed on your account, ACC-356736. We understand that you have raised concerns about the amount reported on your credit report.

We have reviewed the account information and confirmed that the current balance is $6,598.77. We also confirm that the original creditor was Heartland Savings Bank. As per Missouri state law (M.S. § 407.025), we are required to provide you with information about the debt, including the amount owed and the original creditor.

We have investigated the matter and found that the account was charged off on February 2, 2021. We have no record of any payments being made on this account.

We will provide you with a validation of the debt, as per the requirements of the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) 15 U.S.C. § 1692g. This validation will include the amount owed, the original creditor, and any other relevant information.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further, if you believe that the amount owed is incorrect or that you have made payments that have not been credited to your account.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.

narrative:
Several weeks ago a debt collector name Delta Management Associates Inc. phone XXXX located XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, MA. 
or XXXX. XXXX XXXX XXXX, Ma XXXX called me regarding a debt for a XXXX XXXX. I informed them that is not me and to not call again. week of XX/XX/XXXX the company called me again on the same number. On XX/XX/XXXX I received another call on the same XXXX number. This time I spoke with the manager who said his name was XXXX XXXX and he said they would remove me from their call list. However 10 minutes later they called again on a cell phone of mine. I then specifically asked them to remove all phone numbers that have my name listed on it from the area code in which I live. This they refused to do. Although they are referencing my name with the number they wanted me to give them my phone numbers. I told them you are only calling me because my name of XXXX XXXX is associated with this number and because you have associated my name with XXXX XXXX you are calling me. So easily you can find the numbers associated with my name and remove them from your list. They still insisted they won't do this. I believe this is abusive especially since the debt they are calling about is not even the person they are calling. They said they would remove the called numbers from the list yet would not send me a confirmation in email or writing and said only two numbers would be removed. Again I believe it is their job to know who they are calling and is not right to keep calling the same person again who doesn't belong to the debt.

narrative:
Hi, I am reaching out concerning the Debt trying to be collected by the IC Systems pertaining to XXXX XXXX XXXX.

I have never owned XXXX XXXX XXXX services, I have only owned XXXX XXXX previously and transferred to XXXX  for cheaper phone service. 

I haven't lived at the address XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX, NC XXXX in over two years. 

My previous addresses has been XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX, TX XXXX and XXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, Florida XXXX XXXX XXXX My mother resides at XXXX XXXX XXXX, I believe that this was filed incorrectly. I called concerning the letter that was re-routed to me about the debt for {$340.00} to gain insight on what was going on. 

They mentioned that the internet router wasn't returned. Per my mother, she stated she called XXXX XXXX XXXX services to pick up the router and they informed her that they would send someone out to pick up the router. She stated that no one came to pick up the router. I called XXXX XXXX XXXX and asked if she could drop off the router at a local store but, they said she could no longer drop off the router and would have to speak to the debt collector and pay the fee. 

However, the fee is placed under my name and I am not the account holder associated with this company under this address. 

Due to miscommunication, it seems that my mother attempted to drop off the router and have someone scheduled to pick up the router but, due to misinformation it has been to sent to Debt Collectors and placed under my name. 

As mentioned, I have not lived in XXXX, North Carolina for over 2 years since have moved from the city and state. 

I will need this resolved immediately. Please have the removed from my name, credit, account, etc. I have never shared a relationship with XXXX XXXX XXXX I have only had services from two telecommunication services that do not include XXXX XXXX XXXX

narrative: It was in XX/XX/2023 a debt collector called UCB had an entry on my report for {$840.00}. This was the first I knew about this, so I disputed it. Apparently the credit bureaus take the creditors side no matter what, because they left it on my report. Had I been given the chance I would have paid some, but never ever received a bill from these people. From all the complaints I've read about them, neither does anyone else. This is in violation to send this to the credit bureau without contacting me first. Once I disputed it on the credit bureaus I did receive something, but not an invoice or a way to pay it. I guess it was a validation and only after I disputed it with the credit bureaus.

narrative:
Formal Complaint Inaccurate Debt Reporting and Request for Removal I am submitting this complaint to formally dispute a debt that is currently being reported against me, which I believe is false and inaccurate. 
The debt in question does not belong to me, and I have no legal or contractual obligation for it. Despite this, it continues to be reported on my credit file and is negatively affecting my creditworthiness. 
I am requesting that this inaccurate debt be immediately investigated, verified, and removed from my credit report, as required under the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ). Additionally, I request that this false information be removed from all three major credit bureaus to which my Social Security number is reported, including : XXXX XXXX XXXX  If the creditor or collection agency is unable to provide proper documentation proving that this debt is valid and legally mine, it must be deleted in its entirety. 
Please consider this letter as a formal request for the correction of inaccurate credit reporting and compliance with federal consumer protection laws. 
Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. 
Sincerely, [ XXXX XXXX ] [ XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX [ XXXX XXXX, Florida, XXXX ] [ XXXX ] [ SSN- XXXX ] [ XXXX ] [ XXXX ]

narrative:
I received a phone call regarding a debt to XXXX XXXX over the phone. I notified the caller that I did not receive proof of a debt owed and I closed the account in XXXX or XXXX of 2017 for disruptive cable and internet service. The items in question ( Cable boxes and modems ) were returned upon request from XXXX XXXX, which reflected the amount in question. I presented proof of same to the collection agency Sunrise and my attorney sent the collection agency ( Sunrise ) a letter also requesting proof of the debt. 

The Collection agency violated my rights under federal law and NY State law by placing a collection on my credit report for {$350.00} without providing proof of the debt. To date, I have not received proof of any debt nor have my attorney received a response from a letter sent to Sunrise Credit collection clearly stating the debt in question was invalid. I am requesting an immediate correction on my credit report or I will start litigation for damages in Supreme Court.
cfpb_sub_issue: Didn't receive enough information to verify debt
